BiblicalUsage: Who layeth the beams of His chambers in the waters, who maketh the clouds His chariot, who walketh upon the wings of the wind.
TheologicalSignificance: I take from this that the clouds are God's chariot, and no king's chariot ever rode so high.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
